title: Explore financial-table mapping options
description:
## Goal
Compare future financial-table mapping options after the bounded operator-confirmed workflow is established. This is discovery for synthetic statement and invoice tables only.

## Findings
For each option, record inputs, assumptions, fixture-authored expected associations, confidence or ambiguity behavior, and unsupported boundaries. Include accuracy checks and missing, multiple, conflicting, and unsafe controls. Recommend whether a separately authorized implementation decision is warranted.

No automatic mapping is authorized. Do not implement inference, apply unconfirmed suggestions, claim general document support, select a production writer, or define human semantic/AT reviewer authority.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded options comparison records expected associations, assumptions, ambiguity behavior, and limits for each candidate approach. Synthetic controls cover accuracy, missing, multiple, conflicting, and unsafe associations and verify no unconfirmed suggestion is applied. A recommendation identifies any follow-up as a separate decision. The spike does not authorize automatic mapping or general support.
close_reason: Factual correction only: the paper comparison of five mapping options is recorded in docs/research/financial-table-mapping-options-2026-10-16.md; the fixture-controls file contains ten test functions (accuracy match, accuracy contradiction, exact manifest binding, wrong-cell rejection, missing, ambiguous, conflicting, duplicate matching entries, unsafe, and no-unconfirmed-applied) against the hand-authored synthetic statement/invoice manifest (no PDF parsing, no inference, no mapping implementation). Recommendation: Options B/E remain lowest-risk candidates for a future separate decision. No automatic mapping is authorized or implemented. This one-time edit corrects the test-count description only; it does not re-evaluate acceptance or promote tracker data.
